zh: 技能与工具中心（Skill Hub）在「插件与脚本」和「工具」分类下全面上线全员开放/未全员开放标识与分类筛选标签，超级管理员可快速把控开放范围，普通成员更清晰辨识共享资产。
登录页右上角新增浅色/深色主题切换功能，支持一键切换昼夜色调，实时跟随系统偏好与跨页面持久化存储。
移动端全面支持对话列表置顶功能：支持长按会话或点击操作菜单快速置顶/取消置顶，置顶会话常驻列表顶部专区并展示置顶标识，与 Web 端及桌面端会话偏好实时双向云同步。
en: Introduce shared access badges and quick category filters (Shared with all / Not shared) across 'Plugins & scripts' and 'Tools' in Skill Hub, allowing superadmins to clearly inspect distribution coverage at a glance.
Add light and dark theme toggle to the login page top bar, supporting one-click day/night switching with cross-page persistence.
Add conversation pinning to mobile apps: support long-press context menu and action button to pin/unpin conversations to the top, fully synchronized in real-time with Web and Desktop clients.
